summary_for_children: Al-Waqi'ah means The Inevitable Event. It speaks of a day that will surely come, and asks us to look at the seeds we plant, the water we drink and the fire we light, all from Allah.
environment_concept: A field where seeds are planted (56:63), rain falling into a well (56:69) and a tree with a fire for travellers (56:72).
architecture_and_scenery: A farmer's field, a cloud-fed well and a fire with its tree; a quiet horizon for what is unseen.

palette.lighting: Morning field light, then evening fire glow

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A sheltered dry valley at dusk with a sown field, a well, tents and a stone fire ring for travellers

primary_mechanic.text: Kindle the travellers’ fire with a bow drill: steady strokes (too fast slips, too slow loses the heat) until the dust smokes into an ember, then a few gentle breaths with pauses until it flames (56:71-73).

unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading at the top of the valley, readings at the field and the well, then the fire at the camp
world_assets: stone fire ring with bow drill
environment_behaviour: smoke rises as the ember forms
the fire flames and lights the camp
unique_world.learning_objective: Think about who gives the seed, the water and the fire (56:63-72)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Great Event
story_library.children_narration: Surah Al-Waqi'ah reminds us that the Day of Judgment will come. It speaks about different groups of people and asks us to reflect on the creation of human life, crops, water, and fire. These everyday things can remind us how much we depend on Allah.

world_idea.title: The Four Wonders
world_idea.description: Explore educational spaces centered on seeds, water, fire, and human life, connected to reflection on accountability. Do not attempt literal representations of the unseen Day of Judgment.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
story_library.rule_conflicts_resolved: No Day of Judgment imagery; the groups of 56:7-56 are readings only.
